verdict.rationale: Vast.ai exposes a full REST API, CLI, and Python SDK for scripting instance/endpoint lifecycle, plus a dedicated 'vastai agent skill' letting AI coding assistants drive the platform autonomously (create instances, deploy endpoints, manage keys), and scoped API keys explicitly recommended for CI/CD and unattended automation. However there is no evidence of a built-in scheduler, cron-like trigger, or persistent background-automation/orchestration feature within the platform itself — automation here means external scripts/agents calling the API, not a native 'set it and forget it' background job runner. Missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger system, evidence of long-running unattended agent workflows in production, independent confirmation of the agent skill working reliably.
